What really sets this place apart are the thoughtful amenities. The zoom pod is perfect for my client calls and video conferences, and there's no additional charge for using it. Marlies, who owns and manages the space, is absolutely wonderful. Her attention to detail and genuine care for the space and its members really shows. The entire staff is incredibly friendly and professional.
